rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; the Jacobian voxel-wise normative model used data from 7 sites across 5 publicly available datasets (Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS 3, PNC, UK Biobank). The IDP normative model used UK Biobank data with site as a covariate.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC, and UK Biobank, leveraging Jacobian determinant images from nonlinear image registration"; "In total, we used visually quality-controlled T1 Jacobian data from 19,620 participants from seven sites."
rci1_using_msad.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participant demographics and data sources, L335-L337

rci2_using_epd.detail: Five established public datasets used for normative model construction: Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS 3, PNC, and UK Biobank
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "All the data employed in this study were sourced from publicly accessible repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC, and UK Biobank"
rci2_using_epd.location: Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Data - Whole brain voxel-wise Jacobian model, L196-L197

rci3_epd_name.answer: Cam-CAN; HCP; OASIS; PNC; UK Biobank
rci3_epd_name.detail: Cam-CAN used for Jacobian model; HCP (Young Adult) used for Jacobian model; OASIS 3 used for Jacobian model; PNC used for Jacobian model; UK Biobank used for both IDP and Jacobian models
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Ethical approval for all the data used in this study was attained previously by the studies contributing their datasets... the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN), Human Connectome Project (HCP), Oasis, Philadelphia Neurodevelopmental Cohort (PNC) and UK Biobank"

model-1.model-name: IDP normative model (structural, functional, diffusion IDPs)

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase HC (before 50-50 train-test split); model-1 uses UK Biobank IDP data only (Table 1, UKB-IDP row); model-2 pools Cam-CAN (656) + HCP (1,112) + OASIS 3 (2,144) + PNC (1,296) + UKB (14,412) = 19,620 (Table 2, non-CNV rows). Training phase demographics not separately reported; 50-50 train-test split was used with all pathogenic CNV carriers placed in test set.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "In total, we used 44,456 participants in the IDP study, and in the Jacobian-voxel-based study, 19,620 participants passed visual quality control."; "Our dataset was divided into a 50-50 train-test split, with the test set including all participants with pathogenic CNVs."
rci5_n.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Study workflow and data summary, L326-L327; Tables 1 and 2; Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Normative model formulation, L204

model-1.model-name: IDP normative model (structural, functional, diffusion IDPs)

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; model-1 female_n and male_n estimated from total N (43,893) and reported percentages (F%52.4/M%47.6) in Table 1. Model-2 female_n and male_n computed by summing per-dataset estimates from Table 2: Cam-CAN (F=332, M=324), HCP (F=606, M=506), OASIS 3 (F=1218, M=926), PNC (F=673, M=623), UKB (F=7581, M=6831).

model-1.model-name: IDP normative model (structural, functional, diffusion IDPs)

rci7_age.detail: Overall phase; age in years. Model-1 values directly from Table 1 (UKB-IDP row). Model-2 weighted mean and combined SD computed from 5 datasets in Table 2: Cam-CAN (N=656, mean=54.93, SD=18.60), HCP (N=1112, mean=28.80, SD=3.70), OASIS 3 (N=2144, mean=70.60, SD=9.52), PNC (N=1296, mean=14.37, SD=3.45), UKB (N=14412, mean=62.50, SD=7.48). Combined SD accounts for both within-group and between-group variance. Age range from PNC min (8) to OASIS 3 max (97).
